notes: CURRENT-MONTH CLOSING SAVINGS IS NOW DERIVED FROM THE LIVE BALANCES SHOWN AT THE TOP OF THE SHEET, which is what a reader expects of a bottom line and what was asked for.    close = savings now + salary now + income still expected - spending still expected - credit card outstanding - investment contributions still due WHY THIS REPLACES v2026.05.07.04's FORMULA: that version computed previous close + the month's net flow to savings. Two problems followed. (1) BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS VANISHED. The previous close is reverse-walked from the live balance, which strips a current-month adjustment out as a current-month event, and surplus contains no adjustments because an adjustment is neither income nor expense. The two sides cancelled exactly, so a +Rs 11,000 interest credit left the closing balance completely unchanged. Under the new formula adjustments need no special term at all — they are already inside the live balances. (2) THE SALARY ACCOUNT WAS IGNORED. v.04 deliberately excluded it to avoid double-counting salary, which was correct for a chain formula that counted the whole month's income, but wrong here. Salary is a transit account: it zeroes at month end and its residue sweeps into savings, so its balance belongs in the close. Starting from live balances, income already received is sitting in that account and only income still to arrive is added on top, so nothing is counted twice. CARD HANDLING: spending charged to the card has not left cash, so it is excluded from 'spending still expected' and covered instead by subtracting the outstanding balance. Card charges are therefore counted once, whether incurred this month or carried from earlier ones. VERIFIED against the reported figures: Rs 7,85,600 savings + Rs 1,25,332 salary - Rs 1,71,445 remaining spend - Rs 39,845 card - Rs 33,500 SIP = Rs 6,66,142, with the following month opening on that figure and the forward chain re-basing off it. Hand-calculation ties exactly. Both logged adjustments (+Rs 11,000 to savings, +Rs 9,000 to salary) are reflected, since both are inside the live balances. PAST AND FUTURE MONTHS ARE UNTOUCHED: past months still reverse-walk from logged transactions, future months still chain as previous close + planned residue. BUILDS ON v2026.05.07.05 (one-time denominator tied to what the row contributes), v.04 (budget rule applied per planned item; unplanned spending adds rather than being absorbed) and v.01-.03 (stable one-off ids, the journal's 'Counts towards' picker, and the repeating one-off double-count fix). Engine, runProjection and the Decisions tab untouched. No page errors.
